correctness.rationale: Positive four outcomes and survival ensure log finiteness; mean yield greater than survival makes the strict-concavity optimizer positive. Normalization and first-two-moment matching force a single Lagrange-interpolation probability direction; partial fractions give the exact \(s g^2\) divided by four positive annual factors. Integrating proves all-fraction ordering, and derivative crossing gives strict optimal-fraction comparison with the full-germination equality case. The quartic polynomial gives the exact third-moment threshold; convexity of the feasible simplex interval proves unique robust least-favorable law. A Vandermonde rank argument proves three or fewer outcomes impossible. All rational example claims and 5615 supplementary exact assertions verified by check.py.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Cohen implies concavity and the harmonic-mean threshold for an already known law, but not by itself a comparison between different laws sharing their first two moments or a single extremal distribution that is worst for all germination choices. The empirical seed-bank paper compares estimated optimal fractions without fixed-moment four-level ordering. Robust Kelly convexity covers how to formulate the minimax problem, but an arbitrary polyhedral ambiguity set does not have a policy-independent worst vertex. An exact positive fourth-support divided-difference identity establishes this special stronger conclusion. The third-order patch allocation result shares a higher-moment motivation but cannot imply a scalar four-yield dormancy theorem by matching objects/assumptions.

originality.rationale: Inspected primary foundational, germination, and robust log-growth literature, and compared indexed mathematical findings by actual claims. Classical objective, concavity and inverse-yield criterion are explicitly excluded from novelty. The accepted new single claim is a fixed-moment four-yield exact sensitivity/optimizer/robust-law classification plus minimality witness. No inspected primary or research record explicitly covers this complete claim; general higher-order dominance and robust Kelly imply parts or frameworks, and historical priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: Historical novelty not guaranteed beyond inspected primary text, indexed mathematical findings and targeted queries; general Chebyshev-system/higher-order stochastic-dominance literature may contain an equivalent divided-difference order.
Sun–Boyd provides broad robust Kelly optimization machinery; this claim is only the exact special-case structural law, not general robust convexity.
One journal version of motivating study is paywalled; public full-length bioRxiv preprint was read, but later changes could differ.

value.rationale: The two matched-moment four-yield laws have opposite decisions about complete versus partial germination despite identical reproductive mean/variance and plausible 96% seed survival, pinpointing a decision-relevant missing third moment. The exact policy-independent least-favorable probability law over the whole natural moment set solves a robust biological choice analytically; the four-level minimality proves the phenomenon is not possible under smaller common yield alphabets. This is a motivated structural mathematical benchmark rather than a textbook substitution, and no field-validity consequence is claimed.
